data.name: Krishnadas
data.gender_notes: Krishnadas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Krishnadas is derived from two Sanskrit words - Krishna (meaning dark, all-attractive, and divine) and dasa (meaning servant or slave). This name signifies being a devoted servant or devotee of Lord Krishna. It carries the blessings of the divine and the grace of the Almighty. The name Krishnadas carries the meaning “God's grace, Krishna's servant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krishnadas usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, krishna's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and surrender to Lord Krishna.

data.cultural_impact: Transliterated into English from Sanskrit, the name Krishnadas holds deep cultural significance in Hinduism. Krishna is a widely revered deity in Hinduism, adored by millions for his various qualities - kindness, strength, divinity, and military prowess. The name Krishnadas reflects a deep devotion to the deity and a strong connection with the cultural roots of Hinduism.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Krishnadas signifies a soul's deep and unwavering devotion to Lord Krishna. The name symbolizes the desire to serve the divine in all ways, to offer oneself in unconditional surrender, and to seek solace in Krishna's eternal love and grace. It signifies the ardent longing of the soul to merge completely in the divinity of Lord Krishna and to experience the profound bliss of the divine presence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Krishna signifies the all-pervading divine consciousness, while Das represents one who is devoted to that consciousness, symbolizing a life dedicated to the supreme cosmic consciousness.
